headline: Epic's new 'vibe coded' launcher claims to be faster and adds Linux support
summary: Epic released a redesigned Epic Games Launcher in preview, which it says was 'vibe coded' because 'programming is hard.' The company claims the new launcher starts 46% faster than Steam and now supports Linux for the first time, with Epic working to bring Fortnite there too, though it warns the preview app will have some bugs.
